raw_text: Reconciling the wedged inferences deliberately avoided spending any API quota because the underlying data was already valid — the fix was to correct completeness bookkeeping, not to re-run the LLM. Only inferences that were genuinely untagged, which had appeared as the store grew, required live tagging, and those were correctly blocked by the safe-default privacy gate until it was explicitly disabled. This reflects a discipline of distinguishing genuine data gaps from metadata artifacts before consuming billable model calls.
